traceability.notes:
The story docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md describes adding safe, configurable auto-fix behavior for missing @story annotations and simple @story path format issues, plus options to control templates and auto-fix application.
Code implementation matches these requirements: - REQ-AUTOFIX-MISSING: `traceability/require-story-annotation` declares `fixable: "code"` and, via helpers in require-story-helpers.ts and require-story-core.ts, inserts a single-line JSDoc @story annotation before functions/methods/TS declarations when missing. Rule options `annotationTemplate` and `methodAnnotationTemplate` allow overriding the built-in template. Visitors cover all relevant function-like node types, and tests verify the expected before/after outputs. - REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT: `traceability/valid-annotation-format` uses `getFixedStoryPath` and `reportInvalidStoryFormatWithFix` to perform suffix-only path normalization for @story values. It only appends or adjusts `.story`/`.md` suffixes and rejects unsafe paths (e.g., those with `..`). Tests in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts confirm `.story` -> `.story.md` and bare path -> `.story.md` behaviors. - REQ-AUTOFIX-SAFE & REQ-AUTOFIX-PRESERVE: Fixes never touch runtime code, only comments or string literals within comments. `createAddStoryFix` and `createMethodFix` insert comments before nodes; `createStoryFix` computes minimal ranges inside comment text for suffix replacement. Unsafe or ambiguous situations fall back to diagnostics without a fix. - REQ-AUTOFIX-TEMPLATE: `require-story-annotation` options and helpers implement configurable templates, and dedicated tests confirm that custom templates are applied to both functions and methods. - REQ-AUTOFIX-SELECTIVE: Both rules honor an `autoFix` boolean option. When `autoFix` is false, fixes are not applied while diagnostics remain. This is validated for require-story-annotation in tests; valid-annotation-format has the corresponding flag in its resolved options and guards fix application with `options.autoFix !== false`. - Acceptance criteria for core functionality, quality, integration, user experience, and error handling are validated by the combination of targeted unit tests, shared helpers designed for safety, and documentation explaining behavior and constraints.
All relevant tests, including the story-specific auto-fix suite, pass. Documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md clearly describes the auto-fix capabilities and options. Based on this concrete evidence, the story is fully implemented.
